CHECK MAINLINE-027. QUESTIONABLE. Not a certification. The owner's card is not rewritten. The arithmetic is independent of the owner's scripts.

No mismatch at the printed precision. 116 feasible P2 geometries were rescored from the published thicknesses. The worst mode difference is 1.70530256582e-13. The worst structural-mass difference is 1.45519152284e-11 kg.

The R 20 m optimistic aluminium pass, full 021 properties and resized seams, has least factor 1.00748732379, governing joint net section. Global is 1.00748732952. Face thickness is 0.00142313261777 m. The published payload, 209.838630802 kg, rescores at 1. The order's 1.0075 and 209.84 kg are those two figures.

Reserve rows marked as constant, area or volume keep those powers. Joining excess is the resized seam. Climate plus internal air is 0.0573961669466 optimistic and 0.131183154179 conservative. The module counts are 1, 3, 7, 23 and 103.

Every re-optimised P3 bay is inside 0.4 to 3 m, and every outer radius is inside min(0.25 m, s/3). P3 scores match to 3.65218966181e-12. The similarity rows pass 3 m on purpose. The held member force is p*R*s/2. On the equilateral grid it is smaller by sqrt(3). That objection is NFI-CHECK-027-MEMBER-FORCE. It does not move global or film. This check names no next job.
